sents.en: Mosquitoes are insects.
Ants, bees, and beetles are insects too.
Mosquitoes live almost everywhere on Earth.
sents.ko: 모기는 지구 거의 모든 곳에 살아요.

sents.en: They are often found near lakes and ponds.
sents.ko: 호수와 연못 가까이에서 자주 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: Most mosquitoes are white, gray, or brown.
Some mosquitoes are brightly colored.
Mosquitoes have three main body parts.
They are the head, thorax, and abdomen.
Mosquitoes have six legs and two wings.
sents.ko: 모기는 다리가 여섯 개, 날개가 두 개예요.

sents.en: They have two eyes and two antennae.
sents.ko: 눈은 두 개, 더듬이는 두 개예요.

sents.en: A mosquito has a special mouthpart.
It looks like a straw.
All mosquitoes eat nectar and plant juices.
sents.ko: 모든 모기는 꽃의 꿀과 식물의 즙을 먹어요.

sents.en: Only female mosquitoes bite and drink blood.
They bite humans and animals.
Mosquitoes are important.
They are food for many animals and other insects.
sents.ko: 많은 동물과 다른 곤충의 먹이가 되니까요.

sents.en: Oh! I thought mosquitoes only drink blood.
sents.ko: 오! 저는 모기가 피만 마시는 줄 알았어요.

sents.en: But mosquitoes drink from plants too.
I still don't like that they bite my arms and legs though.
sents.ko: 그래도 팔과 다리를 물리는 건 싫어요.

sents.en: I hope you don't get bitten.
I'll see you next time! Have a nice day!
sents.ko: 다음에 또 만나요! 좋은 하루 보내세요!
